source.text: וַיָּשֶׂם֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֧וֹשׁ׀מַ֛ס עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְאִיֵּ֥י הַיָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And laid the king Ahasuerus forced labor on the land and [the] coasts of the sea.

en.L: And King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and the coastlands of the sea.
en.B: King Ahasuerus imposed tribute on the mainland and on the coastlands of the sea.
en.R: King Ahasuerus made the people of his whole empire, even those along the faraway coasts, pay him tribute.

es.L: Y el rey Asuero impuso tributo sobre la tierra y sobre las costas del mar.
es.B: El rey Asuero impuso tributo a tierra firme y a las costas del mar.
es.R: El rey Asuero hizo que la gente de todo su imperio, incluso la de las costas lejanas, le pagara tributo.

fr.L: Et le roi Assuérus imposa un tribut au pays et aux côtes de la mer.
fr.B: Le roi Assuérus imposa un tribut au continent et aux côtes de la mer.
fr.R: Le roi Assuérus a fait payer un tribut aux gens de tout son empire, même à ceux des côtes lointaines.

sw.L: Mfalme Ahasuero akaweka kodi juu ya nchi na juu ya pwani za bahari.
sw.B: Mfalme Ahasuero aliweka kodi juu ya nchi kavu na juu ya pwani za bahari.
sw.R: Mfalme Ahasuero aliwafanya watu wa milki yake yote, hata wale walioishi katika pwani za mbali, wamlipe kodi.

vi.L: Vua A-suê-ru đặt cống thuế trên đất liền và các miền duyên hải của biển.
vi.B: Vua A-suê-ru bắt đất liền và các miền duyên hải phải nộp cống thuế.
vi.R: Vua A-suê-ru bắt người dân khắp đế quốc mình, kể cả những người ở các miền bờ biển xa xôi, phải nộp thuế cho vua.

ko.L: 그리고 아하수에로 왕이 땅과 바다의 해안 지방에 조공을 부과하였다.
ko.B: 아하수에로 왕은 본토와 바다의 해안 지방에 조공을 바치게 했다.
ko.R: 아하수에로 왕은 자기 제국의 모든 백성, 멀리 바닷가에 사는 사람들에게까지 세금을 내게 했다.

pt.L: E o rei Assuero impôs tributo à terra e às costas do mar.
pt.B: O rei Assuero impôs tributo ao continente e às terras do litoral.
pt.R: O rei Assuero fez o povo de todo o seu império pagar tributo a ele, até os que moravam nas costas mais distantes.

am.L: ንጉሡ አሕሻዊሮስም በምድሪቱና በባሕሩ ዳርቻዎች ላይ ግብር ጣለ።
am.B: ንጉሥ አሕሻዊሮስ በየብሱና በባሕር ዳርቻ አገሮች ላይ ግብር ጣለ።
am.R: ንጉሥ አሕሻዊሮስ በግዛቱ ሁሉ ያሉት ሰዎች፣ በሩቅ የባሕር ዳርቻዎች የሚኖሩትም ጭምር፣ ግብር እንዲከፍሉት አደረገ።

hi.L: और राजा क्षयर्ष ने देश पर और समुद्र के तटों पर कर लगाया।
hi.B: राजा क्षयर्ष ने मुख्य भूमि पर और समुद्र के तटीय देशों पर कर लगाया।
hi.R: राजा क्षयर्ष ने अपने पूरे साम्राज्य के लोगों से, यहाँ तक कि दूर दूर के समुद्र-तटों पर रहनेवालों से भी, कर वसूल करवाया।

ru.L: И наложил царь Ахашверош подать на землю и на острова моря.
ru.B: Царь Ахашверош обложил данью и материк, и морские побережья.
ru.R: Царь Ахашверош заставил платить ему дань людей во всём его царстве, даже на далёких морских берегах.

ja.L: そしてアハシュエロス王は、地と海の島々に貢ぎを課した。
ja.B: アハシュエロス王は、本土にも海沿いの国々にも貢ぎを課した。
ja.R: アハシュエロス王は、国じゅうの人々に、遠い海辺に住む人々にまで、貢ぎ物を納めさせました。

decisions.choice: tribute: forced labor or a tax owed to the king
decisions.reason: The word first meant a work gang or forced labor owed to a ruler (1 Kings 9:15, 21), and later a tribute or tax. Here it shows the king's power over all his lands, a fitting setting for Mordecai's greatness in the next verses.

decisions.choice: the land and the coastlands of the sea: the whole empire, to its farthest shores
decisions.reason: The coastlands are the shores and islands of the Mediterranean world, the far edge of the empire (Isaiah 11:11; 24:15). Together with the land the phrase means everywhere he ruled.

decisions.choice: Ahasuerus: the king's name as read aloud
decisions.reason: Here the written Hebrew text has a shorter spelling of the king's name, and the text read aloud has the usual form, Ahasuerus. Both name the same king.

decisions.choice: the people of his whole empire, even those along the faraway coasts
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase as one picture of the whole empire (m2).

decisions.choice: passé simple « imposa » (Literal, Balanced); passé composé « a fait payer » (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in all the narrative of these books: the written narrative tense at Literal and Balanced, the spoken past at Readable.

decisions.choice: mas "貢ぎ" (L, B), "貢ぎ物" (R); iyyei hayyam "海の島々" (L), "海沿いの国々" (B), "遠い海辺" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads tribute owed to the king; the coastlands stand for the empire's farthest shores.

source.text: וְכָל־מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה תָקְפּוֹ֙ וּגְב֣וּרָת֔וֹ וּפָרָשַׁת֙ גְּדֻלַּ֣ת מָרְדֳּכַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר גִּדְּל֖וֹ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ הֲלוֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֨פֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַיָּמִ֔ים לְמַלְכֵ֖י מָדַ֥י וּפָרָֽס׃

records.literal_gloss: And all [the] deeds of his power and his might, and [the] exact account of [the] greatness of Mordecai to which made him great the king, [are] not they written on [the] book of [the] words of the days of the kings of Media and Persia?

en.L: And all the deeds of his power and his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king raised him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
en.B: All his powerful and mighty deeds, and the full account of the high rank to which the king raised Mordecai, are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia.
en.R: Everything the king did with his power and might is written down in the history books of the kings of Media and Persia. Those books also tell the whole story of how the king made Mordecai a great man.

es.L: Y todos los hechos de su poder y de su fuerza, y el relato exacto de la grandeza de Mardoqueo, a la cual el rey lo engrandeció, ¿no están escritos en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Media y de Persia?
es.B: Todos sus hechos de poder y de fuerza, y el relato completo de la alta posición a la que el rey elevó a Mardoqueo, están escritos en el libro de las crónicas de los reyes de Media y de Persia.
es.R: Todo lo que el rey hizo con su poder y su fuerza está escrito en los libros de historia de los reyes de Media y de Persia. Esos libros también cuentan toda la historia de cómo el rey hizo de Mardoqueo un gran hombre.

fr.L: Et tous les actes de sa puissance et de sa force, et le récit exact de la grandeur de Mardochée, à laquelle le roi l’éleva, ne sont-ils pas écrits dans le livre des chroniques des rois de Médie et de Perse ?
fr.B: Tous ses actes de puissance et de force, ainsi que le récit complet du haut rang auquel le roi éleva Mardochée, sont écrits dans le livre des chroniques des rois de Médie et de Perse.
fr.R: Tout ce que le roi a fait avec sa puissance et sa force est écrit dans les livres d’histoire des rois de Médie et de Perse. Ces livres racontent aussi en détail comment le roi a fait de Mardochée un grand homme.

sw.L: Na matendo yote ya uwezo wake na nguvu zake, na habari kamili ya ukuu wa Mordekai, ambao mfalme alimkuza kwao, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Umedi na Uajemi?
sw.B: Matendo yake yote ya uwezo na nguvu, pamoja na habari kamili ya cheo cha juu ambacho mfalme alimpandisha Mordekai, yameandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Umedi na Uajemi.
sw.R: Kila kitu ambacho mfalme alifanya kwa uwezo na nguvu zake kimeandikwa katika vitabu vya historia vya wafalme wa Umedi na Uajemi. Vitabu hivyo pia vinasimulia habari yote ya jinsi mfalme alivyomfanya Mordekai kuwa mtu mkuu.

vi.L: Và mọi công việc về quyền năng và sức mạnh của vua, cùng với bản tường thuật đầy đủ về sự cao trọng của Mạc-đô-chê mà vua đã tôn ông lên, há chẳng được chép trong sách biên niên của các vua Mê-đi và Ba Tư sao?
vi.B: Mọi công việc đầy quyền năng và sức mạnh của vua, cùng với bản tường thuật đầy đủ về địa vị cao trọng mà vua đã ban cho Mạc-đô-chê, đều được chép trong sách biên niên của các vua Mê-đi và Ba Tư.
vi.R: Mọi điều vua đã làm bằng quyền năng và sức mạnh của mình đều được ghi trong các sách sử của các vua Mê-đi và Ba Tư. Những sách ấy cũng thuật lại đầy đủ việc vua đã làm cho Mạc-đô-chê trở thành một người vĩ đại.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 권세와 능력으로 행한 모든 일과, 왕이 모르드개를 높여 준 그 높은 지위에 대한 자세한 기록은 메대와 페르시아 왕들의 역대 기록의 책에 기록되어 있지 않은가?
ko.B: 왕이 권세와 능력으로 행한 모든 일과, 왕이 모르드개를 높여 준 높은 지위에 대한 자세한 기록은 메대와 페르시아 왕들의 역대 기록의 책에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 왕이 자기 권세와 능력으로 한 모든 일은 메대와 페르시아 왕들의 역사책에 기록되어 있다. 그 책들에는 왕이 모르드개를 어떻게 위대한 사람으로 만들었는지도 자세히 적혀 있다.

pt.L: E todos os atos do seu poder e da sua força, e o relato completo da grandeza de Mardoqueu, a que o rei o elevou, não estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis da Média e da Pérsia?
pt.B: Todos os seus atos de poder e de força, e o relato completo da alta posição a que o rei elevou Mardoqueu, estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis da Média e da Pérsia.
pt.R: Tudo o que o rei fez com o seu poder e a sua força está escrito nos livros de história dos reis da Média e da Pérsia. Esses livros também contam toda a história de como o rei fez de Mardoqueu um grande homem.

am.L: የኃይሉና የብርታቱ ሥራ ሁሉ፣ ንጉሡም ከፍ ያደረገው የመርዶክዮስ ታላቅነት ሙሉ ዘገባ በሜዶንና በፋርስ ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?
am.B: የኃይሉና የብርታቱ ሥራ ሁሉ፣ ንጉሡም መርዶክዮስን ከፍ ያደረገበት ታላቅ ማዕረግ ሙሉ ዘገባ በሜዶንና በፋርስ ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፏል።
am.R: ንጉሡ በኃይሉና በብርታቱ ያደረገው ሁሉ በሜዶንና በፋርስ ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጻሕፍት ተጽፏል። እነዚያ መጻሕፍት ንጉሡ መርዶክዮስን እንዴት ታላቅ ሰው እንዳደረገው የሚገልጸውን ታሪክ በሙሉ ደግሞ ይናገራሉ።

hi.L: और उसकी शक्ति और उसके पराक्रम के सब काम, और मोर्दकै की उस बड़ाई का पूरा वर्णन, जिस तक राजा ने उसे पहुँचाया, क्या वे मादै और फ़ारस के राजाओं के इतिहास की पुस्तक में नहीं लिखे हैं?
hi.B: उसकी शक्ति और पराक्रम के सब काम, और उस ऊँचे पद का पूरा वर्णन जिस तक राजा ने मोर्दकै को पहुँचाया, मादै और फ़ारस के राजाओं के इतिहास की पुस्तक में लिखे हैं।
hi.R: राजा ने अपनी शक्ति और पराक्रम से जो कुछ किया, वह सब मादै और फ़ारस के राजाओं के इतिहास की पुस्तकों में लिखा है। उन पुस्तकों में यह पूरी कहानी भी है कि राजा ने मोर्दकै को कैसे एक बड़ा आदमी बनाया।

ru.L: А все дела его власти и его могущества и точный рассказ о величии Мардохея, до которого возвеличил его царь, — разве не записано это в книге летописи царей Мидии и Персии?
ru.B: Все его дела, полные власти и могущества, и подробный рассказ о высоком сане, до которого царь возвысил Мардохея, записаны в книге летописи царей Мидии и Персии.
ru.R: Всё, что царь совершил своей властью и силой, записано в летописи царей Мидии и Персии. В этих книгах подробно рассказано и о том, как царь сделал Мардохея великим человеком.

ja.L: そして彼の力と彼の勇ましさのすべての業と、王が彼を大いなる者としたモルデカイの偉大さについての詳しい記述は、メディアとペルシアの王たちの日々の出来事の書に書き記されているではないか？
ja.B: 王の力と勇ましさを示すすべての業、また王がモルデカイを高い地位に就けたことについての詳しい記録は、メディアとペルシアの王たちの年代記に書き記されている。
ja.R: 王がその力で行ったことは、すべて、メディアとペルシアの王たちの記録の書に書いてあります。王がモルデカイを偉い人にしたことも、そこにくわしく書いてあります。

decisions.choice: the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia
decisions.reason: Literally "the book of the words (or events) of the days", the royal annals in which deeds were recorded, as Mordecai's warning about the plot was (2:23; 6:1). The wording is like the closing notes on the kings of Israel and Judah (1 Kings 14:19, 29).

decisions.choice: are they not written: a question that means "they are written"
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer yes. It points the reader to the official record, as the books of Kings do.

decisions.choice: the full account: an exact statement
decisions.reason: The word means an exact or detailed account; it is used in 4:7 of the exact sum of silver Haman promised.

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer yes (m2); Balanced and Readable state it, which says the same in plain English. Literal keeps the question.

decisions.choice: o Livro das Crônicas dos Reis da Média e da Pérsia (L, B); os livros de história dos reis (R)
decisions.reason: The closing note takes the wording of the source notes of Kings in Portuguese, "o Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel" (m1), with capitals as the name of a book, and keeps the question at Literal, as the English does; Readable says what the books were.

decisions.choice: Literal "... የተጻፈ አይደለምን?"; Balanced, Readable "... ተጽፏል።"
decisions.reason: The closing reference to the royal chronicles follows the formula of Kings on main; "Media and Persia" keeps the Hebrew order here (ሜዶንና ፋርስ), against "Persia and Media" in 1:3.

decisions.choice: "क्या वे ... इतिहास की पुस्तक में नहीं लिखे हैं?" (Literal), the wording of the regnal source formula in Kings and Chronicles
decisions.reason: The question is the closing formula of the books of Kings, here for the kings of Media and Persia, so Literal keeps the history books' wording; Balanced and Readable state it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "разве не записано это в книге летописи"
decisions.reason: The question keeps the wording of the source formula of Kings and Chronicles in this translation ("Разве это не записано в книге летописи царей..."), so the reader hears the same formula at the close of Esther.

decisions.choice: The rhetorical question kept at Literal ("…ではないか？"), a statement at Balanced and Readable, as the English; sefer divrei hayyamim lemalkhei Madai uFaras "…日々の出来事の書" (L), "…年代記" (B), "…記録の書" (R), with "メディアとペルシア" in the Hebrew order
decisions.reason: As 2:23 and the regnal formulas of Kings.

source.text: כִּ֣י׀מָרְדֳּכַ֣י הַיְּהוּדִ֗י מִשְׁנֶה֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ וְגָדוֹל֙ לַיְּהוּדִ֔ים וְרָצ֖וּי לְרֹ֣ב אֶחָ֑יו דֹּרֵ֥שׁ טוֹב֙ לְעַמּ֔וֹ וְדֹבֵ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם לְכָל־זַרְעֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For Mordecai the Jew [was] second to the king Ahasuerus, and great to the Jews, and accepted by [the] multitude of his brothers, seeking good for his people and speaking peace to all his offspring.

en.L: For Mordecai the Jew [was] second to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and pleasing to the multitude of {{gender:his kindred|his brothers}}, seeking good for his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.
en.B: For Mordecai the Jew was second in rank to King Ahasuerus. He was great among the Jews and well liked by his many fellow Jews, because he worked for the good of his people and spoke up for the well-being of all their descendants.
en.R: Mordecai the Jew was second in power only to King Ahasuerus. He was an important man among the Jews, and his many fellow Jews thought highly of him. He worked for the good of his people and spoke up for the safety of all their families.

es.L: Porque Mardoqueo el judío [era] el segundo después del rey Asuero, y grande entre los judíos, y grato a la multitud de {{gender:sus parientes|sus hermanos}}, buscando el bien de su pueblo y hablando paz a toda su descendencia.
es.B: Porque Mardoqueo el judío era el segundo en rango después del rey Asuero. Era grande entre los judíos y muy querido por sus muchos compatriotas, porque procuraba el bien de su pueblo y hablaba en favor del bienestar de toda su descendencia.
es.R: Mardoqueo el judío era el segundo en poder, solo por debajo del rey Asuero. Era un hombre importante entre los judíos, y sus muchos compatriotas lo apreciaban. Trabajaba por el bien de su pueblo y hablaba en favor de la seguridad de todas sus familias.

fr.L: Car Mardochée le Juif [était] le second après le roi Assuérus, et grand parmi les Juifs, et agréable à la multitude de {{gender:ses proches|ses frères}}, cherchant le bien de son peuple et parlant de paix à toute sa descendance.
fr.B: Car Mardochée le Juif était le second en rang après le roi Assuérus. Il était grand parmi les Juifs et aimé de ses nombreux compatriotes, parce qu’il recherchait le bien de son peuple et parlait en faveur du bien-être de toute sa descendance.
fr.R: Mardochée le Juif avait le plus grand pouvoir après le roi Assuérus. C’était un homme important parmi les Juifs, et ses nombreux compatriotes l’estimaient beaucoup. Il travaillait pour le bien de son peuple et parlait en faveur de la sécurité de toutes leurs familles.

sw.L: Kwa maana Mordekai Myahudi [alikuwa] wa pili kwa mfalme Ahasuero, na mkuu kati ya Wayahudi, na mwenye kukubaliwa na wingi wa ndugu zake, akitafuta mema kwa watu wake na kunena amani kwa uzao wake wote.
sw.B: Kwa maana Mordekai Myahudi alikuwa wa pili kwa cheo baada ya mfalme Ahasuero. Alikuwa mkuu kati ya Wayahudi na alipendwa na Wayahudi wenzake wengi, kwa sababu alitafuta mema kwa watu wake na kunena kwa ajili ya ustawi wa wazao wao wote.
sw.R: Mordekai Myahudi alikuwa na mamlaka ya pili baada ya mfalme Ahasuero tu. Alikuwa mtu muhimu kati ya Wayahudi, na Wayahudi wenzake wengi walimheshimu sana. Alifanya kazi kwa ajili ya mema ya watu wake na kunena kwa ajili ya usalama wa familia zao zote.

vi.L: Vì Mạc-đô-chê, người Do Thái, [là] người thứ hai sau vua A-suê-ru, và cao trọng giữa người Do Thái, và được đông đảo {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình ưa thích, tìm điều tốt cho dân mình và nói lời bình an cho cả dòng dõi mình.
vi.B: Vì Mạc-đô-chê, người Do Thái, là người đứng hàng thứ hai sau vua A-suê-ru. Ông được tôn trọng giữa người Do Thái và được đông đảo đồng bào yêu mến, vì ông tìm điều tốt cho dân mình và lên tiếng vì sự bình an của cả dòng dõi họ.
vi.R: Mạc-đô-chê, người Do Thái, có quyền lực chỉ đứng sau vua A-suê-ru. Ông là một người quan trọng giữa người Do Thái, và đông đảo đồng bào rất quý trọng ông. Ông làm việc vì lợi ích của dân mình và lên tiếng vì sự an toàn của mọi gia đình họ.

ko.L: 이는 유대인 모르드개가 아하수에로 왕 다음가는 [자였고], 유대인 가운데서 크고, 그의 많은 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}에게 사랑을 받았으며, 자기 백성의 선을 구하고 자기 모든 자손에게 평안을 말하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 유대인 모르드개는 아하수에로 왕 다음가는 지위에 있었다. 그는 유대인 가운데서 존귀한 사람이었고, 많은 동족에게 사랑을 받았다. 그가 자기 백성의 선을 구하고 그 모든 자손의 평안을 위해 말했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 유대인 모르드개는 아하수에로 왕 다음으로 큰 권력을 가졌다. 그는 유대인 가운데서 중요한 사람이었고, 많은 동족이 그를 존경했다. 그는 자기 백성이 잘되도록 힘쓰고, 그들의 모든 가족이 평안하도록 그들을 위해 말했다.

pt.L: Pois Mardoqueu, o judeu, [era] o segundo depois do rei Assuero, e grande entre os judeus, e agradável à multidão dos seus {{gender:parentes|irmãos}}, buscando o bem do seu povo e falando de paz a toda a sua descendência.
pt.B: Pois Mardoqueu, o judeu, era o segundo em autoridade depois do rei Assuero. Ele era importante entre os judeus e muito estimado pelos muitos judeus do seu povo, porque trabalhava pelo bem do seu povo e falava em favor do bem-estar de todos os seus descendentes.
pt.R: Mardoqueu, o judeu, só tinha menos poder que o rei Assuero. Ele era um homem importante entre os judeus, e os muitos judeus do seu povo o admiravam. Ele trabalhava pelo bem do seu povo e falava em favor da segurança de todas as suas famílias.

am.L: አይሁዳዊው መርዶክዮስ ከንጉሡ ከአሕሻዊሮስ ቀጥሎ ሁለተኛ፣ በአይሁድም ዘንድ ታላቅ፣ በብዙ {{gender:ወገኖቹ|ወንድሞቹ}} ዘንድ ተወዳጅ፣ ለሕዝቡ መልካምን የሚሻ፣ ለዘሩም ሁሉ ሰላምን የሚናገር [ነበረ]ና።
am.B: አይሁዳዊው መርዶክዮስ በማዕረግ ከንጉሥ አሕሻዊሮስ ቀጥሎ ሁለተኛ ነበረና። ለሕዝቡ መልካም ነገርን ይሠራና ለዘሮቻቸው ሁሉ ደኅንነት ይናገር ስለ ነበረ በአይሁድ ዘንድ ታላቅ፣ በብዙ ወገኖቹ አይሁድ ዘንድም ተወዳጅ ነበረ።
am.R: አይሁዳዊው መርዶክዮስ በሥልጣን ከንጉሥ አሕሻዊሮስ ቀጥሎ ሁለተኛ ነበረ። በአይሁድ ዘንድ ታላቅ ሰው ነበረ፤ ብዙዎቹ ወገኖቹ አይሁድም በጣም ያከብሩት ነበር። ለሕዝቡ መልካም ነገር ይሠራ ነበር፤ ለቤተሰቦቻቸውም ሁሉ ደኅንነት ይቆም ነበር።

hi.L: क्योंकि यहूदी मोर्दकै राजा क्षयर्ष से दूसरे [स्थान पर था], और यहूदियों में बड़ा, और {{gender:अपने भाई-बहनों|अपने भाइयों}} की भीड़ का प्रिय था, जो अपनी जाति की भलाई चाहता और अपने सारे वंश से शान्ति की बातें करता था।
hi.B: क्योंकि यहूदी मोर्दकै पद में राजा क्षयर्ष से दूसरे स्थान पर था। वह यहूदियों में बड़ा था और अपने बहुत से यहूदी भाई-बंधुओं का प्रिय था, क्योंकि वह अपनी क़ौम की भलाई के लिए काम करता था और उनके सारे वंश के कुशल-क्षेम के लिए आवाज़ उठाता था।
hi.R: यहूदी मोर्दकै शक्ति में केवल राजा क्षयर्ष से ही नीचे था। वह यहूदियों में एक बड़ा आदमी था, और उसके बहुत से यहूदी भाई-बंधु उसका बड़ा आदर करते थे। वह अपनी क़ौम की भलाई के लिए काम करता था और उनके सब परिवारों की सुरक्षा के लिए आवाज़ उठाता था।

ru.L: Потому что Мардохей-иудей [был] вторым после царя Ахашвероша, и великим у иудеев, и угодным множеству {{gender:своих сородичей|своих братьев}}, ища блага своему народу и говоря о мире всему своему потомству.
ru.B: Ведь иудей Мардохей был вторым по сану после царя Ахашвероша. Он был велик у иудеев и любим множеством своих соплеменников, потому что заботился о благе своего народа и говорил в защиту благополучия всех их потомков.
ru.R: Иудей Мардохей был вторым человеком в царстве после царя Ахашвероша. Он был важным человеком среди иудеев, и многие его соплеменники очень уважали его. Он трудился на благо своего народа и заступался за безопасность всех их семей.

ja.L: ユダヤ人モルデカイは、アハシュエロス王に次ぐ者であり、ユダヤ人の間で大いなる者であり、彼の多くの同胞に喜ばれ、自分の民の幸いを求め、自分のすべての子孫に平和を語ったからである。
ja.B: ユダヤ人モルデカイは、アハシュエロス王に次ぐ地位にあった。彼はユダヤ人の間で重んじられ、多くの同胞に慕われた。自分の民族の幸いを求め、そのすべての子孫の平和のために語ったからである。
ja.R: ユダヤ人のモルデカイは、アハシュエロス王の次に力のある人になりました。モルデカイはユダヤ人の間で重んじられ、多くの仲間のユダヤ人に尊敬されました。自分の民族のためにつくし、そのすべての家族が安全に暮らせるように働きかけたからです。

decisions.choice: second to the king: the highest office under the king
decisions.reason: Mordecai holds the place Haman had (3:1; 8:2), next to the king himself, like Joseph in Egypt (Genesis 41:40-43).

decisions.choice: accepted by the multitude of his brothers: approved by most of his fellow Jews
alternatives: accepted by most of his kinsfolk
decisions.reason: The word means pleasing or well received. "Brothers" means his kinsfolk, the Jewish people, men and women alike. "The multitude" may mean the many, or most of them.

decisions.choice: seeking good and speaking peace: working for the welfare of his people
decisions.reason: To seek someone's good is to work for their welfare (Nehemiah 2:10; Ezra 9:12), and to speak peace is to speak for their well-being (Psalm 85:9; Zechariah 9:10). His offspring here most likely means his people and their descendants, not only his own family; the book had said Mordecai raised Esther but names no children of his own (2:7).

decisions.choice: his kindred / his brothers
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means fellow Jews of both sexes, so Literal uses the gender setting; Balanced and Readable say "fellow Jews".

decisions.choice: because he worked for; all their descendants (B); all their families (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable link his good name to his work for his people, which the Hebrew sets side by side, and read "his offspring" as the descendants of his people (m3).

decisions.choice: {{gender:sus parientes|sus hermanos}}
decisions.reason: As in the English Literal: 'brothers' means fellow Jews, men and women; Balanced and Readable say «compatriotas».

decisions.choice: {{gender:ses proches|ses frères}}
decisions.reason: As in the English Literal: 'brothers' means fellow Jews, men and women; Balanced and Readable say « compatriotes ».

decisions.choice: {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}
decisions.reason: As in the English Literal: 'brothers' means fellow Jews, men and women; Balanced and Readable say đồng bào.

decisions.choice: {{gender:형제자매|형제}}
decisions.reason: As in the English Literal: 'brothers' means fellow Jews, men and women; Balanced and Readable say 동족.

decisions.choice: parentes, with irmãos as the alternative
decisions.reason: As the English Literal: "irmãos" here means his kinsfolk, the whole Jewish people, women and men (m2); the default "parentes" says that, and the traditional "irmãos" is the alternative. Balanced and Readable say "os judeus do seu povo", as the English says "fellow Jews".

decisions.choice: {{gender:ወገኖቹ|ወንድሞቹ}}
decisions.reason: For "brothers" meaning fellow Jews, Amharic has two real wordings, the inclusive ወገኖች and the literal ወንድሞች, as the addendum for this batch sets out; Balanced and Readable say "his fellow Jews" (ወገኖቹ አይሁድ), as the English.

decisions.choice: gender span at Literal: "अपने भाई-बहनों" by default, "अपने भाइयों" as the alternative
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means fellow Jews of both sexes; the span uses the oblique form the New Testament uses for brothers and sisters. Balanced and Readable say "यहूदी भाई-बंधु" (fellow Jews), as the English does, with no span.

decisions.choice: {{gender:своих сородичей|своих братьев}}
decisions.reason: As in the English: "brothers" here means fellow Jews, men and women (m2). Literal gives the inclusive "сородичей" by default and the traditional "братьев" as the alternative; Balanced and Readable say "соплеменников".

decisions.choice: The English gender span (his kindred / his brothers) has no Japanese span: "同胞" is already inclusive
decisions.reason: As style 7a: Japanese that already includes men and women takes no span.
